content.title: Pokémon Champions release time and preload options
content.text: Here's what time Pokémon Champions will be playable in your region. Image credit: The Pokémon Works Pokémon Champions is the latest multiplayer Pokémon game that'll allow you to use your Pokémon to battle against other players, both casually and in ranked modes. Releasing on Nintendo Switch – and eventually on mobiles too later in the year – you might be wondering exactly when it'll be available to play; that's where this Pokémon Champions release time guide comes in handy. So that you can dive into Champions' strategic multiplayer battles as soon as possible, here's the Pokémon Champions release time, and whether or not you can preload the game. On this page: Release time and date Can you preload? Pokémon Champions release time and date Pokémon Champions releases on Wednesday 8th April, 2026 for Nintendo Switch and Nintendo Switch 2. Mobile ports for Android and iOS versions of the game are also anticipated later in 2026. As for what time you'll be able to play on Wednesday, Nintendo and Pokémon Works are yet to share an official release time for the game. However, most games released to the Nintendo eShop typically become available at midnight globally, meaning you should be able to install the game once it reaches midnight in your region. The only exception to this rule is North America, which features different time zones across the region. In this instance, the game will be available at 12AM EDT. This is actually 9PM PDT for those along the west coast of North America, meaning those in the likes of Los Angeles, San Francisco, Seattle and more will be able to play the game a little earlier than the rest of the globe. Lucky you! Image credit: The Pokémon Works Can you preload Pokémon Champions? You cannot preload Pokémon Champions on Nintendo Switch at the time of writing. While the Nintendo eShop page for the game is available to view, the only options available to you here are to wishlist the game; there is no option to preload. On top of that, Nintendo and the Pokémon Works have not yet revealed what Pokémon Champions' file size will be. That said, we anticipate that it won't be too big of a download. Recent releases Pokopia and Pokémon Legends: Z-A required just 6.2GB of storage space maximum each, so here's hoping Pokémon Champions follows suit. Have fun playing Pokémon Champions once it releases in your region!
